conclusion: Reproduced an actor-dependent drag update-rate difference. Selected Multiply with two Inspector fields triggers repeated whole-document detached captures through two notification paths. Removing Inspector FieldTargets in a disposable control removes the actor asymmetry. Synchronous snapshot and projection work dominates these fixtures; shader arithmetic is not implicated. Both I4 and R5 show the same capture counts and source paths.

hypothesesAndLimits: The Human actual graph, operation type, browser origin and FPS overlay implementation are unknown; no Butterfly node is inferred.
The local headless SwiftShader environment reproduces comparative asymmetry, not the exact Human rendering environment or a universal FPS guarantee.
Snapshot allocation is a supported dominant explanation, but no repair was applied or timed. Proposed speedups are not measured.
Only4/14-node,3-edge,zero-nested,one-context fixtures were measured. Large/nested/multicontext performance is not qualified.
Three repeats and non-concurrent matrix order permit thermal/system drift; distributions and trace overhead are retained.
Unchanged projection signatures do not imply writable/busy/token/lifetime notifications may be removed.
Setup harness failures, source-copy preparation corrections and the excluded pilot remain preserved; none invalidate historical independently authored product PASS or qualify a new product build.

boundedProposal.firstChoice: Within production/src/application/editor.ts, derive each synchronous EditorContext.capture/network and FieldTarget.capture from one already-detached GraphSnapshot and resolved occurrence. Reuse that call-local network for nodes/links/labels/frames rather than repeatedly invoking context.network()/graph.capture(). Keep output detached/frozen and all current guard/notification semantics. No cross-revision cache required.
boundedProposal.whySmallest: EditorContext.capture currently calls network five times, each network captures Graph twice, on top of its own Graph capture (11 total). Each FieldTarget.capture adds two network calls (15 Graph captures).12 field captures/publication alone account for180 Graph captures. Call-local reuse attacks the measured multiplier without weakening validation or scheduling.
